steps.title: Find the port by its label
steps.action: Find the port by reading its label, not by counting ports
steps.cue: A finger on the labeled port
steps.why: Counting goes wrong when a row is skipped or the panel is mounted upside down
steps.consequence: You pull a live cable someone else depends on

steps.title: Pull the old cable straight out
steps.action: Press the latch and pull the old cable straight out
steps.cue: The old cable comes out level with the port
steps.why: Pulling at an angle bends the latch and the port pins
steps.consequence: The port stops holding a cable

steps.title: Label both ends of the new cable
steps.action: Label both ends of the new cable before plugging it in
steps.cue: A label on each end of the new cable
steps.why: So the next tech can trace it without pulling every cable
steps.consequence: Someone has to unplug cables one by one to find this one

steps.title: Plug in and leave a slack loop
steps.action: Plug the new cable in and leave a little loop of slack
steps.cue: The cable clicks in and hangs in a small loop
steps.why: Slack keeps the cable from pulling on the port when something moves
steps.consequence: A tight cable works loose or snaps the latch
